sql:
SELECT te.id,te.bookId,b.title,tt.text,src.id,src.lineIndex,l.id,l.targetBookId,t.title,l.targetLineId,dst.lineIndex,
(SELECT count(*) FROM link l2 WHERE l2.sourceLineId=l.sourceLineId AND l2.targetBookId=l.targetBookId AND l2.connectionTypeId=l.connectionTypeId) AS sameWorkTargets
FROM tocEntry te JOIN tocText tt ON tt.id=te.textId JOIN book b ON b.id=te.bookId
JOIN line src ON src.id=te.lineId JOIN link l ON l.sourceLineId=src.id AND l.sourceBookId=te.bookId
JOIN connection_type ct ON ct.id=l.connectionTypeId JOIN book t ON t.id=l.targetBookId
JOIN line dst ON dst.id=l.targetLineId
WHERE upper(ct.name)='COMMENTARY' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM link_suppressed_side s WHERE s.linkId=l.id AND s.side=0)
ORDER BY te.bookId,src.lineIndex,l.id LIMIT 25
